FACTUAL CONSTRAINTS: WHAT KODELY ACTUALLY DOES (real, shipped, verified today): - User describes a site in plain English in a chat interface. - Kodely generates a REAL Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 app — real component files, not a template. - Every project starts from a real foundation with hand-built UI primitives. - Live preview renders the actual compiled app as it's built. - One-click Publish puts the site live on a real public URL: .kodely.site — free, included. - Further changes: describe them in chat; Kodely edits the real components. - Checkpoints: rollback to a prior version is free. - Code view: see and copy generated source in-app. NO zip/full-project download. - Credits: metered from real AI cost. A build that fails to compile is never charged. - Free tier: 750 credits on signup, no card required. Paid top-ups: $9->500, $40->2,500 (most popular), $90->6,000 credits. WHAT KODELY DOES NOT DO YET — never claim these: - No backend, database, auth, or payments generation — frontend only, for now. - No custom domains, no code export/zip (view/copy only), no click-to-edit visual editing (chat only). - Do NOT use "first month of hosting free" (wrong product) or "yours to keep" as a download/ownership claim (you can view/copy source, not export a project archive). - No "Bring it online with Nxeon" integration — not real, don't reference an "Agency plan" either, it doesn't exist. VOICE: Direct, confident, specific to an early-stage founder's real problems: needing a landing page fast to validate an idea, test messaging, or capture early signups before writing a line of code themselves. 2-3 REAL, concrete use cases (e.g. "validate an idea before building it," "a landing page to collect a waitlist," "a quick site for a fundraising conversation"). No fake testimonial — do not invent a fabricated customer quote/testimonial attributed to a "real" person; either omit that section or frame it generically without a fake attributed quote.
